entry1.paragraph:
Your data is safe with us. All your information is stored exclusively locally on your phone in an SQLite database and secured using strong 256-bit AES encryption. This ensures that no one but you has access to it. We value data privacy and deliberately refrain from saving or sharing your data on external servers.

When using the email service, your email address, password, and mail server configuration are protected using the same strong encryption before data processing. This guarantees your sensitive details remain protected at all times. Your privacy is our top priority — you stay in full control of your data.

entry2.subheading: How does the email server work?
entry2.paragraph:
With our email service, you can easily send your completed application portfolio directly to your chosen company — all you need is their recipient address. The subject line as well as a pre-formulated message body are created for you automatically, keeping the process fast and convenient.

Your data is transferred using secure 2048-bit encryption to our server, which decrypts the portfolio and forwards it directly to the recipient. No logs are kept and no data is persistently stored — information remains temporarily cached in memory and is deleted immediately after delivery.

We are actively working on a fully local version of this feature to give you even greater autonomy over your data in future releases. This service is completely optional and free to use.

entry3.paragraph: You can either create a brand-new cover letter or reuse an existing one. For around 1 cent per generation, you can generate a tailored cover letter customized to your desired role. Alternatively, you can reload an older cover letter, pick a new employer, update the contact person, and edit the body copy as needed. This saves valuable time while keeping you flexible across multiple submissions.

entry1.title: 1. General Information
entry1.text: This Privacy Policy explains how the application tool collects and processes personal information.

entry2.title: 2. Data Collection and Processing
entry2.text:
The tool collects only the data strictly necessary to prepare your application documents:
• Target job title
• Relevant skills and experience
• Application type

entry3.title: 3. Storage and Security
entry3.text: All personal data is saved exclusively on your local device and encrypted with AES-256-bit encryption.

entry4.title: 4. Third-Party Sharing
entry4.text: No identifiable personal data is disclosed to third parties. Only anonymized prompt data required for content generation is transmitted to AI service providers.

entry5.title: 5. User Rights
entry5.text: Users retain the right to review, rectify, and delete all locally saved records at any time.

entry6.title: 6. Changes to this Policy
entry6.text: This privacy statement may be updated periodically. The latest active revision is always accessible directly inside the app.

entry3.title: Disclaimer
entry3.text: The contents of this app have been created with the utmost care. However, we cannot assume liability for the accuracy, completeness, or up-to-date nature of the content. Use of the app is at your own risk.

entry4.title: Copyright
entry4.text: All materials within this app are protected by copyright law. Any reproduction, distribution, or commercial exploitation outside permitted statutory limits requires explicit written permission from the rights holder.
